newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa futures called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa futures called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open little changed on Tuesday, although some traders said the market was likely to come in firmer after gains overnight in London.
London cocoa futures were higher early Tuesday on fund short-covering. At the midday break, LIFFE December was up 16 stg, to 1,066 stg, after trading in a 1,068-1,058 stg range.

Monday, New York cocoa futures rallied sharply on chart-driven speculative buying. December jumped $51 per tonne, to $1,563, after ranging from $1,569 to $1,528. Spot September soared $57, to $1,543, while the back months finished up $39 to $44.
Another 12 delivery notices were issued against September on Tuesday, bring the total to 22.
On the charts, traders said December faced resistance at $1,570, with the next level seen at $1,587-$1,590. On the downside, support was seen near $1,550, followed by $1,543.
